Secp256k1.publicKey.notes: Byte-oriented composition of pinned ecdsa@8.0.1 APIs. Input decoding, strict length/range validation, operation, SEC1/DER/compact serialization and array-to-Blob conversion are measured. Only reusable curve construction and immutable input literals are outside timing. Fixture comes from the independent frozen curve oracle; no plugin outputs were used. Typed error text differs from the native API; comparison is for this valid input. The pure Motoko key multiplication is variable-time; this is a mathematical output comparison and does not assert the native secret operation and this reference have equivalent side-channel properties.
